_doc: Point-in-time retrospective. Every input was public on as_of; see sources. Hindsight lives only in outcome.json.
methodology: house v2 (EPP-distance adjustment), 6-section format; retro method r2: scenario inputs derived from dated facts by frozen rules (retro/README.md); cruise-line signals

pit_profile.why: Royal Caribbean: 'Together, these six brands operate a combined 41 ships in the cruise vacation industry with an aggregate capacity of approximately 98,650 berths as of December 31, 2012'; 'We compete principally on the basis of exceptional service provided by our crew; innovation and quality of ships; variety of itineraries; choice of destinations; and price'; 'We may lose business to competitors throughout the vacation market'; and 'The demand for cruises is affected by international, national and local economic and geopolitical conditions' (its own FY2012 10-K): a cruise-fleet franchise whose demand follows the economies it sells into, by its own account; no disruption theme is live for it

classification.quality_note: Royal Caribbean: 'Together, these six brands operate a combined 41 ships in the cruise vacation industry with an aggregate capacity of approximately 98,650 berths as of December 31, 2012'; 'We compete principally on the basis of exceptional service provided by our crew; innovation and quality of ships; variety of itineraries; choice of destinations; and price'; 'We may lose business to competitors throughout the vacation market'; and 'The demand for cruises is affected by international, national and local economic and geopolitical conditions' (its own FY2012 10-K): a cruise-fleet franchise whose demand follows the economies it sells into, by its own account; no disruption theme is live for it. durable franchise (obsolescence risk 2/5); price rich; +85% to EPP floor; model-vs-market gap -0.68; conservative 2yr -27%.

BEAR.desc: EPS -73.5%/yr (worst year FY03-FY12, capped at 0%); P/E to its 10th pct

BASE.desc: EPS +2.1%/yr (Q4 cc guide + margin + buyback); P/E at its 10-yr median

BULL.desc: EPS +3.7%/yr (FY03-FY12 CAGR); P/E holds its 75th pct

XBULL.desc: EPS +97.5%/yr (best 2-yr run FY03-FY12); P/E at its 90th pct

summary: RCL (retrospective, 2013-12-31) ✕ AVOID — Ratio B infx (95.8% downside to Bear $2 / +-11.4% upside to Bull $42) | Adj composite 2.20 vs market 2.88: gap -0.68 [OVERVALUED] | +85% above the EPP floor $26 (11x FY13E $2.33) | Conservative 2-yr case: -26.9% total (-13.5%/yr) | At 20.4x FY13E the 15% hurdle price $63 sits above the BULL case; Net Yields +2.6% in Q3 2013, forward net revenue +2-3% (Q4 2013 net revenue guide at constant currency); no disruption theme has dated evidence.
